properties.Description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

systemReady.Description: Indicates whether the system is ready. `true` when every readiness category has reported 100 percent.

categories.Description: The readiness state reported for each provider-defined category.

categoryName.Description: The provider-defined name of the readiness category (for example, `services`, `diagnostics`, `identity`, `networking`). Categories may be added, renamed, or removed without an API-version change and must be treated as an open string.

readinessPercentage.Description: The readiness percentage reported by the category, from 0 (not ready) to 100 (fully ready).

errorMessageDetails.Description: The error messages reported for the category. The list is empty when no specific errors are available.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
